title: Body handle validation, reverse association and retirement
status: Static body-handle, reverse-association and retirement references.

checks.label: staging publishes descriptor containing ECS handle at +0x30
VM body consumer resolves reverse association from world scene owner
endpoint validation reads full handle table
second population branch stores reverse association
actor creation publishes body table pointer after encoded identity
release tail clears native body pointer
physics removal path retires body handles

scene_record.0x28: separate content identity field; not the runtime ECS handle
scene_record.0x30: ECS handle copied from query chunk header during staging 0x191ede0
scene_record.0x38: structured data pointer; not an ECS handle or scalar resource ID
scene_record.validation: Revalidate world, ECS generation/location, Physics scene slot and reverse body association in an owning callback before use.

scene_owner.0x1d0: native actor pointer array, count +0x1d8, capacity +0x1dc
scene_owner.0x2e0: free-list head used by the reviewed retirement path
scene_owner.0x2e8: reverse-association view: owner pointer +0, pair array +8, count +0x10
scene_owner.0x300: 16-byte association records containing instance pointer and local body index

live_handle.low_word: slot index; live table entry must contain that same index
live_handle.high_word: generation compared by endpoint validation; reviewed retirement adds two
live_handle.validation: 0x2cf08d0 checks bounds and equality of both words for optional endpoints; leaf actor lookup does not

actor_identity.encoding: 0x2d83c60 preserves the handle high word and stores (index * 2) | 1 in the low word
actor_identity.retirement: 0x2d83e20 writes UINT64_MAX before virtual slot zero, then clears the actor pointer table
